title: Herlihy and Wing, Linearizability, 1990
finding: Explicit competing return-commit/close events; canonical state distinct from response notification.
limit: No actual C publication or ABI proof.

title: Michael, Hazard Pointers, 2004
finding: Logical removal is not safe reclamation; protection requires lookup/pin or publish/revalidation before hazardous access.
limit: No transplanted lock-free/wait-free or performance guarantee for the selected bounded gate design.

title: WG14 N1570 committee draft
finding: Ordinary concurrent field accesses require race freedom; native jump needs original thread/live invocation.
limit: Not a compiler/builtin/Darwin acceptance receipt; atomic decrement alone adds no operation identity.

title: OCaml C interface, manual 5.3
finding: Learn explicit managed-root lifetime and bounded callback/cleanup permissions.
limit: Not an implementation of Gambit marker/full-continuation or still GC contracts.
